finding: The generator and validator require frame outer width >=5, but the canonical hidden query has width 4. The wrong width-guarded crop fits both visible canonical demonstrations and every ordinary generated frame, then fails the query.
rival_rule: Crop the strict interior only when the cyan frame outer width is at least 5; otherwise return the input unchanged.
generator_domain_statement: Ordinary generation chooses frame width >=5 and self_check calls color_rect_frames(..., min_outer_w=5), so no accepted generated pair refutes the width guard.
canonical_statement: The two visible training frames have width 5; the canonical test frame has width 4.
